candidate.derivedAnswer: A. There exists a real number that is not greater than 0
candidate.answerReason: Negating “every real number is greater than 0” gives “there exists a real number that is not greater than 0,” including equality with 0.

methods.label: Negating a universal statement
methods.explanation: The negation of a universal statement is an existential statement, with the conclusion also negated. It does not simply change “all” to “all are not.”
methods.levelReason: The method applies the required rule for negating a statement containing one quantifier.
